reason: Every measurement in the finding is right and the conclusion built on them is not. Driven in chromium at file://.../lately.html?v=light&state=quiet at 1440x960 with reduced motion: 'Nothing is sitting' is a P.t-head at document y=739, 20px/600, ink #111111, inside section[aria-labelledby=m2q]; 'How long open work has been sitting' is an H3.t-head at y=963, 20px/600, ink #111111, same section; 963-739=224px, and the heading list between them is empty (t-sect at 576, then nothing until 'What this can't tell you' at 1213). 'sitting' matches exactly twice in main.innerText in quiet and exactly once in full, partial, first-run and loading. The ages card reads 'Oldest - 12 days' over nine dots at ages 1,2,3,4,6,7,9,11,12, zero of them .old. So the seat's geometry, ranks and counts are all correct. What fails is the premise. The finding has to assign 'sitting' a technical meaning in the first heading - 'stalled past a fortnight' - to make the second heading collide with it, and the surface never says that. It says the fortnight idea precisely everywhere it means it: the KPI card is 'haven't moved in a fortnight', the spoken line is 'open longer than a fortnight', and the quiet body directly under the headline is 'All 9 open jobs have moved inside a fortnight, none is past its day, every one has a name on it, and none is waiting on anything else.' The finding cites that same precision as evidence for itself ('every other place the surface names this idea it says it precisely') without noticing it is evidence against: 'sitting' is precisely NOT the technical term on this surface, it is the informal umbrella for work left unattended - which is the identical sense the ages heading uses. One sense, two scopes, not two senses and certainly not 'opposite'; the finding's own body concedes the second is a superset of the first ('stalled past a fortnight' vs 'open'), which is not what its title claims. Second, the pair is claim-and-proof, not claim-and-refutation. I looked at the rendered band rather than arguing about it: below 'Nothing is sitting' the ages card draws all nine rings to the LEFT of a drawn, labelled 'A FORTNIGHT' rule at 14d on a 15d axis, oldest at 12, and speaks '0 jobs have been open longer than a fortnight.' The card the finding calls the contradiction is the receipt. That is exactly what the r1 remediation of quiet-state-contradicts-its-own-evidence was built to produce (that state used to show 41 days and three .old marks under the same headline), and this finding does not claim a regression and there is none. Third, severity is overstated, which the brief makes a refutation ground on its own. Nothing on the screen is wrong: both headings are true, the marks prove the claim, the threshold is drawn. 'Defect' means visibly wrong but passable; this is at most a word echo a copy editor might tighten, which is 'refinement - nothing is wrong'. The lab's own ledger settles the calibration: the-all-clear-sentence-drops-one-of-its-four-categories (r2) was a strictly more substantive gap in THIS card - a whole condition genuinely unsaid - and was confirmed at refinement on the reasoning 'the sentence asserts nothing untrue, so it is not misleading, and it is not a defect'. Grading a two-use echo a defect would rank it above an actually-missing clause. Worth adding against the consequence as written ('read cold... the surface contradicting itself'): at the shipped frame size the second heading's top is at y=963 against a 960px viewport, so the two are not even co-visible in light-quiet--1440x960.png without a scroll. Fourth, the fix is a downgrade. 'Nothing is slipping' 163px under the 26px section heading 'What's quietly slipping' echoes the container's own word back at it, and trades the warmer, physical, owner-voiced line - the one paired with the emerald check in the single state whose job is to be believed - for the surface's abstract category label. The lexical bridge from the all-clear to the strip is already 'fortnight' (the body says 'moved inside a fortnight'; the strip draws the rule), not 'sitting', so nothing is gained on that side either. The one genuinely valuable thing in this filing is the gate observation, and it is worth more than the copy edit and is independent of it - see sharpenedFix.
sharpenedFix: Do not change the copy. Take only the gate half, and take it as a standalone hardening. interaction-check.mjs:817 computes `reassures: /Nothing is sitting/.test(text)` and line 826 guards the whole assertion block with `if (claim.reassures)`. I confirmed by grep that nothing else anywhere in the lab asserts the all-clear exists: the string appears in interaction-check.mjs only at 817 and 827, and no build step, no frames.json entry and no derive-fixture check reads it. So the block is one copy edit away from silently never running in any of the 4 states x variants it loops - which is precisely the vacuous-assertion class the round notes value above the defects that expose them, and the fifth instance of it if it lands. Close it without touching a pixel: replace the bare guard with an assertion that the flag is true in exactly the state that must carry it - `ok(`the quiet state states its all-clear - ${state} @ ${variant}`, claim.reassures === (state === "quiet"))` - and keep the existing `if (claim.reassures)` block underneath. Better still, stop keying on a copy string at all: mark the element (`.card .center .t-head`, or a data attribute on the reassurance card) and test for the node, so the assertion survives any future rewording. That change is copy-independent, cannot regress a frame, and is the finding's only durable contribution.
breaks: The rejected copy fix, had it landed, would have needed: the gate key at interaction-check.mjs:817 moved in the same commit or the block at 826-830 goes vacuous across full/partial/quiet/first-run x every variant; shots/light-quiet--1440x960.png and its dark twin re-shot (glyph-to-head centring is unchanged in height, but the frame carries the string); and a re-read of the word against the section title it would then duplicate at two ranks 163px apart. The recommended gate hardening breaks nothing on the surface - it is test-only, adds one assertion per state/variant to the 461, and needs only interaction-check.mjs re-run to confirm it passes in quiet and fails-by-design nowhere else. audit.mjs is untouched: it reads palette, weights, families, contrast, hit targets, radii, motion, ramp and leading, none of which sees an assertion or a string.
